title: ononis viscosa var. brachycarpa
intro: Ononis viscosa var. brachycarpa, commonly known as Spiny Burn Clover, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is traditionally used to treat various ailments such as diarrhea and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Spiny Burn Clover include antioxidant, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily comprised of alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
